user_goal: Implement W2 Phase 05 Product UX and Judge Demo: create a receipt-centered local demo that renders persisted runs, context, trace, diff, verification, acceptance evidence, and benchmark results with truthful status and accessible error states without starting Phase 06.
complexity_reasons: demo server and browser smoke coverage
functional_requirements: Provide Runs and Run Receipt views centered on the three W2 questions
Expose context, trace, diff, verification, acceptance evidence, and benchmark views from stored artifacts
Provide npm run demo deterministic local entry point with empty, failure, unproven, and integrity-error states
Document product UX and demo flow and add UI smoke tests
nonfunctional_requirements: UI values come from persisted receipts and benchmark results
UNPROVEN is visually and textually distinct from PASS
Keyboard-visible focus, semantic labels, readable contrast, and laptop-friendly responsive layout
constraints: Do not start Phase 06 packaging or unrelated dashboard features
Use existing TypeScript stack and avoid a redundant frontend framework

semantic_relevance.name: persistence
rules: rendered values are derived from stored receipt and benchmark artifacts

semantic_relevance.name: testing
rules: browser smoke checks cover the hero flow and error states

semantic_relevance.name: security
rules: demo does not expose secrets or arbitrary filesystem paths

semantic_relevance.name: time
rules: receipt timestamps remain visible and unmodified

acceptance_criteria.statement: Receipt is the primary view and outcome is immediately visible with PASS FAIL UNPROVEN ABORTED or ERROR semantics
Context, trace, diff, verification, acceptance evidence, and benchmark data are inspectable from persisted artifacts
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: UI smoke test and artifact projection test

acceptance_criteria.statement: UI values are sourced from stored receipts/results and UNPROVEN cannot appear as PASS
npm run demo starts a deterministic local demo without hidden setup
Empty, failed, unproven, integrity-error, approval, budget, and interrupted states render explicit messages
Primary navigation and receipt sections have semantic labels, visible focus, and color-independent status text
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: static UI audit and smoke test
